servoGateDiagPanel.panelDescription: Drive the Waveshare BLE bridge's gates directly to test open/close/calibrate - independent of the sorter's normal layer-gate mapping.
servoGateDiagPanel.notWaveshareBle: Diagnostics are only available for the Waveshare BLE backend. Switch to it in Settings above to use this.
servoGateDiagPanel.deviceMissing: No BLE device address is saved yet. Set one in Settings above first.

gatesPanel.title: Known gates
gatesPanel.emptyHint: No gates found yet. Press Rescan, or Learn next servo below if none have been onboarded.

servoGateDiagPanel.footerHint: Learn next servo onboards the next factory-default servo found at ID 1 and calibrates it. Factory-reset all clears every reachable servo back to ID 1 so onboarding can start over.
